title: fix(metadata): a packages[] stack's top-level dataset no body declares registers under the stack's id
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ85xEThZCGWjgxwVAkAhF4sq)_
Fixes #29518

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — no file under `skills/**` teaches a `packages[]` stack's top level, its residual, or a `_packageId` stamp on a top-level dataset; every taught dataset sits in a single-package stack, which has no residual.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：多包 stack（带 `packages[]`）顶层声明、但没有任何包体声明的 `datasets` 条目，现在按 ADR-0130 D4 的残余规则登记在 stack 自己的 `manifest.id` 下；构建门（spec 镜像）与启动门同步判断它的 `_packageId` 印记。
- 为什么改：之前这种数据集既不登记也不报错，被静默丢弃；引用它的仪表盘或报表要到运行时才失败，离原因很远。
- 风险与回滚：顶层带外包 `_packageId` 印记的残余数据集现在会被拒（之前静默丢弃），故声明 narrowed；另外 artifact 启动时各包体的数据集也会进入元数据服务（封闭运行时 `GET /meta/dataset` 不再为空）。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/metadata/src/plugin.ts`（`ARTIFACT_FIELD_TO_TYPE` 新增 `datasets`）、`packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts`（`TOP_LEVEL_COLLECTIONS_NEVER_RESIDUAL` 去掉 `datasets`）、新 pin `manifest-service-residual-objects.test.ts` 的 datasets 块。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/manifest-service-residual-objects.test.ts -t datasets`，预期 2 个用例全绿（构建依赖闭包后）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位契约复核后落地。

## What changes

- `packages/metadata/src/plugin.ts`: `ARTIFACT_FIELD_TO_TYPE` gains `datasets: 'dataset'`, with a comment saying why and that the seed `data:` collection stays unmapped. That one map is what the residual rule (`unclaimedTopLevel`) walks, so a `packages[]` stack's top-level dataset that no body declares is now listed as residual. Both boot doors register it under the stack's manifest id and version (the metadata door through `registerUnclaimedTopLevel`, the engine through the `manifest` service's existing residual seam, unchanged), and both apply the owner-stamp refusal they already apply to every other residual item.
- The same map is the artifact door's body loop, so every package body's datasets also reach the metadata service from a compiled artifact, with provenance. Before, only the ObjectQL registry took them (its `METADATA_ARRAY_KEYS` loop).
- `packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts`: the build-door mirror `TOP_LEVEL_COLLECTIONS_NEVER_RESIDUAL` drops `datasets` and keeps `data` and `jobs`; its docblock says why. Not exported, so no API-surface or generated artifact moves. Triage designated this a cross-domain single PR (6585309156); PR #29514 had merged first.
- `packages/spec/src/stack-collection-item-owner-stamp.test.ts`: the "filed by no boot door" case drops `datasets`; a new case pins that a foreign-stamped residual dataset raises the judge's issue at `datasets.0._packageId`.
- `packages/metadata/src/owner-stamp-residual-build-boot.test.ts`: the reading becomes `['data', 'jobs']`, and the comment above it no longer says datasets are read off the stack whole (the rider from the contract review of PR #29514, record 6583699079).
- `scripts/check-stack-collection-maps.mjs`: the `ARTIFACT_FIELD_TO_TYPE` waiver row loses `datasets` from its keys (the gate reds a stale waiver) and its text no longer says AppPlugin consumes datasets off the bundle; it says why the key left.
- New pin block in `packages/objectql/src/manifest-service-residual-objects.test.ts`: a residual dataset registers under the stack's manifest id and version beside a body's own; CONTROL: a top-level dataset a body repeats stays the body's, registered once.
- One changeset: `minor` for `@objectstack/spec` and `@objectstack/metadata` (the kind is `narrowed`), carrying the three declaration lines and the fix for an author whose stack now refuses.

## Why

ADR-0130 D4's residual rule exists so a top-level item is either registered or refused, never silently lost. `datasets` had no `ARTIFACT_FIELD_TO_TYPE` entry, so the rule never saw it. Measured on a kernel boot (`ObjectKernel` + `ObjectQLPlugin`, the stack handed to the `manifest` service as `AppPlugin` hands it): nothing thrown, `listItems('dataset')` answered the body's dataset only, and no line named the residual one.

## Tests

- Red first, at the commit that adds the pin (before the fix): `registers a residual dataset under the stack's manifest id and version, beside a body's own` failed (`expected [ [ 'acme_case_body', …(2) ] ] to deeply equal [ [ 'acme_case_body', …(2) ], …(1) ]`); the CONTROL passed. With the mapping: 62/62 in that file.
- Reverse verification of the spec pin, at the final head: putting `datasets` back into `TOP_LEVEL_COLLECTIONS_NEVER_RESIDUAL` turns the new spec case red (1 failed, 47 passed); restored with `git checkout HEAD --`, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Before the spec line, the metadata mirror test was red exactly as predicted (`datasets: build verdict == unclaimedTopLevel lists it (true): expected false to be true`); with it, 27/27.
- Suites: at head `ae0a25e6` (the last commit adds only the changeset's ADR-0087 marker), each under the verify lock: `@objectstack/spec` 888 files / 25184 tests passed (1 todo); `@objectstack/metadata` 68 / 956 passed; `@objectstack/objectql` `manifest-service-residual-objects.test.ts` 62/62. The full `@objectstack/objectql` suite (535 files / 10398 tests) and `@objectstack/runtime` suite (527 files / 9695 passed, 19 skipped) passed with the mapping before the rebase onto `ff827bcf`; the spec line changes no runtime path they exercise. `typecheck` exit 0 for spec, metadata and objectql.

## Acceptance notes

- Artifact boot measured before and after (scratch probe, deleted). `createStandaloneStack` over a multi-package artifact with a residual dataset: `getMetaItems({ type: 'dataset' })` went from the body's dataset only to body + residual (owner `com.probe.release`), and `getMetaItem` for the residual went from a stub with no item to the served item. Single-package artifact: `/meta/dataset` unchanged; the metadata service's own list went from empty to the body dataset. The artifact door alone (as a sealed runtime runs it, no AppPlugin): `manager.list('dataset')` went from empty to every body's dataset plus the residual, each stamped with its package id and version, and the residual `warn` counts the dataset with the other residual items. No boot failed in any reading.
- `jobs`, `datasources` and `translations` stay on the waiver row: they are a different fact (AppPlugin does consume them off the bundle) and were not measured here.

## Verification

All readings at head `ae0a25e6`, merge base `ff827bcf`.

<details><summary>Derived gates: 101 derived, 100 exit 0, 1 NOT MEASURED; plus pnpm lint</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 101 commands from the 7 changed paths; every one was run and its exit code recorded, and `--ran` reconciled the record: `101 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 100 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED`.
- First pass: `check-adr-0087-registration` exited 1 (the narrowed changeset had no ADR-0087 marker); the marker commit makes it exit 0 (`not-required (no-migration-prescription)`), and every changeset-reading gate was rerun on that head (no-major, empty-changeset, changeset-gate-self-tests, doc-authoring, issue-citations, nul-bytes, closing-keyword-parity, stack-collection-maps): all exit 0. `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` exited 3 until its pinned control commit was fetched, then 0.
- NOT MEASURED, reason: prerequisite not met (exit 3). `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` needs every package built; CI's Build Core runs it.
- `pnpm lint`: exit 0. `node scripts/check-stack-collection-maps.mjs --self-test`: exit 0 (18 assertions).

</details>

`test:repo` was not run locally (it belongs to CI's Test Core). Dogfood battery at `dd552104` (owed by the `(narrowing)` arm): closure built, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the verify lock, VERDICT command-exit 0; Test Files 397 passed | 3 skipped (400), Tests 3277 passed | 28 skipped (3305), no failures.
